page_title: SAL 1-2 ROM | Salernitana v AS Roma 29/01/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+6' The match has just finished.
90+2' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) rises above the defence and heads a precise cross towards the left post. His effort, however, is blocked by Rui Patricio, who pulls off a stunning save!
90+1' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle as Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) used excessive force in the tackle during an attack.
90' There will be a minimum of 5 min. of added time.
90' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) puts a dangerous cross into the box, but the corner is cleared by the first man.
89' Rui Patricio (AS Roma) is awarded a yellow card for his behaviour.

89' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) receives a precise pass on the edge of the box and shoots. His poorly placed shot flies well wide of the left post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
88' Here comes a substitution. Dean Huijsen (AS Roma) is brought on as a substitute for Lorenzo Pellegrini.
88' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) gets a yellow card.
87' Filippo Inzaghi is stunned as referee Marco Di Bello shows him a yellow card. What was that for?
86' There's a melee in the box, but the referee isn't interested in the appeals from Salernitana for a penalty. Play continues.
84' Although Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is just on the bench, Marco Di Bello has awarded him with a yellow card. Unsporting behavior says the referee.
82' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) delivers a fine lofted cross into the penalty area, but it's cleared by an opposing player.
79' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) delivers a lovely cross into the penalty area. Nevertheless, an opposition defender is alert and averts the danger with a brilliant clearance.
78' Daniele De Rossi has decided to make a change. Nicola Zalewski (AS Roma) replaces Stephan El Shaarawy.
78' The referee signals a substitution. Alessandro Zanoli (Salernitana) is brought on as a substitute for Niccolo Pierozzi.
78' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) commits a foul and Marco Di Bello immediately signals a free kick.

77' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) unleashes a decent strike heading to the bottom right corner, but the keeper dives like Superman and keeps it out. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
73' Substitution. Norbert Gyomber leaves the pitch and is replaced by Matteo Lovato (Salernitana).
73' Here is a change. Simy is going off and Filippo Inzaghi gives the last tactical orders to Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana).
73' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is penalised for a foul. Marco Di Bello had a clear view and blows his whistle.
71' Paulo Dybala goes off the pitch and Houssem Aouar (AS Roma) comes on.

70' 1 - 2 It's a goal! Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) makes it 1:2. He jumped highest to connect with a perfect cross from Loum Tchaouna and planted his close-range header into the left side of the goal. Rui Patricio was helpless.
69' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) swings in the corner kick, but one of the defenders leaps highest to head the ball away.

68' A sweet pass finds Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) on the edge of the box, and he drills the ball towards the middle of the goal. Rui Patricio is almost caught out but pulls off a brilliant save at the last second. The linesman makes the right call and Salernitana will have a corner.
66' 0 - 2 Goal! Rick Karsdorp tees up Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) inside the box, and he keeps his cool to find the left side of the goal. 0:2.

65' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) picks up a lofted cross inside the box and fires a quick shot to the middle of the goal. His promising effort is kept out by Guillermo Ochoa, who pulls off a stunning save! Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) finds himself in an offside position and the referee stops play after the linesman raises his flag.
64' Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) quickly takes the free kick with a short pass.
63' Diego Llorente (AS Roma) commits a rough challenge and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
62' Filippo Inzaghi has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Grigoris Kastanos (Salernitana) replacing Toma Basic.
62' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Agustin Martegani (Salernitana) comes onto the pitch so that Junior Sambia can be given a rest.

61' What a chance that is! Antonio Candreva swings the ball into the box, and Simy (Salernitana) gets in front of his man and powers his header just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
61' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
60' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) trips an opponent with a slide tackle. Marco Di Bello stops the game and he could give him a card, but eventually decides on just a warning.
59' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) is deemed to be in an offside position by the linesman and it looks like it is the right decision despite being a very close call.
58' Paulo Dybala is not given a chance to finish after receiving a sweet pass by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma).
57' The AS Roma players are exchanging short passes in an attempt to create a shooting opportunity.
53' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) fails to pick a body out in the box with an over-hit chip pass.
51' 0 - 1 GOAL! That’s a great strike from the spot by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) low into the left of the net, giving goalkeeper Guillermo Ochoa no chance!
51' Paulo Dybala (AS Roma) is heading towards the penalty spot to take it.
51' The penalty decision stands after the VAR review. It's a penalty!
49' Giulio Maggiore (Salernitana) handles the ball inside the box. AS Roma are about to take a penalty!
49' The resulting corner, taken by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), comes to nothing.
49' The defence is alert as they clear a dangerous cross from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma). Now AS Roma have a corner.
46' The second half has just started.
45+5' The first half of today's match has just finished.
45+4' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) was quite harsh and Marco Di Bello didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle, a clear handball by Paulo Dybala (AS Roma).

45+1' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) misses a great opportunity to convert the free kick from the edge of the penalty box after firing the ball high over the crossbar of the goal. The ball goes out of play and Salernitana will have a goal kick.
45' We will have 3 min. of added time.
44' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is yellow-carded for breaking the rules of the game.
42' The ratio of the ball possession is 27:73.
40' Simy (Salernitana) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Marco Di Bello has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
39' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner but it's cleared.

39' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) produces a quality cross into the box, but the opposition's defence intercepts the ball and spanks it away. The referee and one of his assistants signal for a corner kick to Salernitana.
39' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence quickly intercepts the ball.
38' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) takes the corner with a short pass.

38' Simy (Salernitana) produces a poor pass. He attempts to get the ball into the box but it's hacked away. Salernitana have been awarded a corner kick. The referee and one of his assistants both point at the corner flag.
37' Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Marco Di Bello blows his whistle for a foul.
35' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) latches on to a precise cross on the edge of the box and strikes the ball goalwards. However, it goes just over the crossbar.
34' The players claim that Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) handled the ball and it seems they are right.
32' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) gets inside the box and tries to beat Rui Patricio with a measured shot into the bottom right corner, but the keeper is equal to the effort and makes a fine save.

31' Domagoj Bradaric (Salernitana) finds himself in space on the edge of the box and smashes a glorious looking effort towards the bottom right corner, but Rui Patricio thwarts him with a great two-handed save.
28' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) is moving okay again after that injury scare.
27' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) requires medical treatment, so the referee stops play and signals for the physio to come onto the pitch.
27' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) robs an opponent of the ball and explodes in anger when Marco Di Bello blows for a foul.
26' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) sends a teasing cross into the area, but Rui Patricio intercepts the ball.

24' Antonio Candreva (Salernitana) skips perfectly past challenges but misdirects his shot from the edge of the box. The ball flies a few yards over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for AS Roma.
24' Rasmus Kristensen (AS Roma) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
22' Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball to safety.
20' Romelu Lukaku receives a sweet cross inside the box from Gianluca Mancini (AS Roma), but one of the defenders rushes in bravely to intercept the ball.
17' This shall not pass! Romelu Lukaku (AS Roma) lines up a shot from the edge of the box and goes for goal, but the effort is well blocked by a defender.
15' Stephan El Shaarawy receives a sweet pass inside the box from Paulo Dybala (AS Roma), but one of the defenders is first to the ball and makes an interception.
13' Bryan Cristante (AS Roma) attempts to find Romelu Lukaku, but puts far too much on the pass and the chance is gone.
13' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) seems to be alright and is okay to carry on.
12' Niccolo Pierozzi (Salernitana) is down injured and the referee stops play so that he can receive medical treatment.
9' A fine lofted pass into the box, sent by Lorenzo Pellegrini (AS Roma), is intercepted by the opposition's defence. The ball has crossed the sideline. AS Roma are taking a throw-in.
8' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) finds himself beyond the last defender but the linesman raises his flag for offside.
7' Rough tackle by Bryan Cristante (AS Roma). The referee blows his whistle for a foul.
6' Marco Di Bello blows his whistle and it's Simy (Salernitana) who is penalised for an offensive foul. Good decision by the referee.
5' Salernitana keep possession of the ball with some short passes, waiting for the moment to hit the opposition swiftly on the break.
3' Stephan El Shaarawy (AS Roma) is adjudged to have been offside when making his run.
2' A quickly taken corner by Salernitana.
2' A pass into the penalty area from Simy (Salernitana) is intercepted by the defence. Salernitana force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.

The players are out and the match is about to start. AS Roma will have the kick-off.
Marco Di Bello will referee today's match.
